initialExam.title: CDS II Examination 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Defence Services Exam II for entry into IMA, INA, AFA, and OTA. Exam scheduled September 13, 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: English (100 marks), General Knowledge (100 marks), Elementary Mathematics (100 marks for IMA/INA/AFA only).
initialExam.examPattern: IMA/INA/AFA: 3 papers, 300 marks. OTA: 2 papers, 200 marks. SSB Interview: 300 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Officer in Indian Army (IMA), Navy (INA), Air Force (AFA), or OTA
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lt Colonel → Colonel → Brigadier.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Free mess, CSD, Medical, Pension, Canteen facilities, Adventure training
